name: Mottle the Tortie Cat
blurb: Mottle, a small tortoiseshell with black and ginger patches blended like soft brushstrokes and honey-gold eyes, sunbathes on warm stones.

name: Umber the Deep-Brown Cat
blurb: Umber, a sleek shorthair with a deep umber-brown coat that looks almost black in the shade and warm copper eyes, naps under the fig tree.

name: Sprig the Trim Tabby Cat
blurb: Sprig, a lean, long-legged grey tabby with neat dark stripes and green eyes, eats small, slow suppers, then takes one lap of the garden.
